channel.title: Sift Weekly
channel.description: One agent failure, taken apart every Friday. Sift is a fictional product used for a layout study.

item.title: The refund that ran twice
item.description: A support agent retried a payment tool after a timeout and reported one refund when two had gone out.

item.title: The tool that said yes to everything
item.description: A permissions check that returned true for any user the agent named.

item.title: Context that went stale at step nine
item.description: A travel agent quoted a fare it had fetched eight steps earlier.
